recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If FMG wants to update a live tracking spreadsheet or wiki/governance page, that should be handled outside the FHIR core source checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-5553 was a Published FHIR-core DSTU1 change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking for a page that lists the resources and profiles each work group is responsible for cultivating. The accepted resolution was to add a direct link to the FMG tracking spreadsheet from the external FHIR wiki page.
initial_application: No source file or git commit was found that explicitly mentions FHIR-5553. The Jira record and comment trail indicate the applied action was outside this checkout: a FHIR wiki link to the FMG tracking spreadsheet under Organizational > Governance.
additional_context: The current core build now has active workgroup ownership metadata in source/fhir.ini and a built FHIR Workgroup List Report at source/wglist.html, wired through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. That report was introduced later by FHIR-12164 and now satisfies the implementer-visible ownership-by-workgroup view without needing a new page or spreadsheet link in current core source. Community searches found no Confluence reference to FHIR-5553 and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The seed's final applied action was an external wiki/governance link, and the current core specification already has a maintained workgroup report and per-artifact ownership metadata.
